name: isURLFilteringProfileEnabled
definition: True when the running configuration of every rulestack a managed firewall uses has a URL filtering profile set (not the none default).
population: running rulestack configurations used by the managed firewalls; denominator = every rulestack a firewall uses
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every firewall (the firewall list and the per-firewall reads agree) and of the running configuration of each local and global rulestack it uses, each showing a URL filtering profile other than none.
citations: Public OpenAPI reference for Cloud NGFW for AWS, pan.dev openapi-specs/cloudngfw/aws (ManageNGFW, ManageRulestacks, ManageCertificateObjects), rendered at https://pan.dev/cloudngfw/aws/api/

changeLog.change: Registered so the Cloud NGFW transform can emit it. Meaning written from the public reference only; no customer read, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Presence of a profile, not its strength: a custom profile is not graded. Whether other firewall tools should answer this key is not ruled.
